author: Isengrim93
quote:
Overhyped and disappointing.
Several years of waiting and an inflated $80 price for a game with less freedom amd features than previous titles. 
The pacing in the early part of the game leaves much to be desired. It feels like a significant part of the original spirit of GTA games has been sacrificed for the sake of a story that is generally lackluster. I don't care about these characters enough to have my in-game choices so restricted. 
Hopefully this can be salvaged with mods once it releases on the PC and goes on a good sale.

author: Isengrim93
quote:
This game is a faithful recreation of the N64 original with stunning visuals, some QoL improvements, and an updated soundtrack that make the added cutscenes/context hit even harder. 
Best of all, in my opinion, they did not alter major aspects of the game to cater to modern sensitivities. Put simply, this now the best way to experience one of the greatest games of all time.
